description: Reference scenario s3-policy-tightened (twin) on the synthetic student of fixtures/students/marcus: "The instructor tightens the policy mid-week". Load with env.load_seed at virtual_now 2027-03-09T08:00:00-05:00 with this binding.json and the package's fixtures/policies.json, then apply the twin setup in ../scenario.json.

sources.description: Hand-written synthetic student, courses, AI policies, essays, comments, grades and course threads (fixtures/profiles/marcus.json); recurring problems are planted across the graded essays. No external collection, no real people, courses or schools, and no third-party text.

Records written by hand for the scenario (examples/scenarios/s3-policy-tightened/scenario.json). Both members: Monday evening the assistant suggested two wording fixes on v3, allowed then: a semicolon for the comma splice (pc6) and a page number for the citation (pc8). Setup: on Wednesday Dr. Lindqvist changes Philosophy 101's policy and explains it in the thread, and Marcus accepts Monday's comma-splice fix as v4. Twin only: Wednesday's change removes only content suggestions: wording and grammar suggestions are still allowed, and the message says so.

transformations: Paragraphs split into sentences under second-draft-edit-kind/1, every seeded sentence authored by the student; versions numbered v1, v2, ... in saving order; policy entries, replies, submissions and grades given sequential IDs.
Scenario changes applied to the full fixture marcus, then the twin changes.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace the author's check of every record and human review of realism and variation.
